description:
### Changed
- **Add Stremio button** now works correctly with [Nuvio](https://github.com/tapframe/NuvioStreaming), a Stremio-addon client that also registers the stremio:// scheme but doesn't understand its URL shape. Previously, tapping the button just opened Nuvio's home screen instead of the film.
- The button now checks which of Nuvio or Stremio is installed and sends each its own correct deep link. Nuvio is preferred when both are present.
- The label and color switch to match: purple "Stremio", or blue "Nuvio" (using the blue from Nuvio's logo).

patches.name: Add Stremio button
patches.description: Adds a purple Stremio button directly below the trailer button on film pages, styled identically to it. Takes the trailer button's position when there is no trailer. Opens the film directly in the Stremio app or web player.

patches.name: Hide Spotlight Ad
patches.description: Hides the sponsored "Spotlight" ad card on the home feed. Can be toggled independently of the other patches.

patches.name: Hide Video Store
patches.description: Hides the "Rent from Letterboxd Video Store" banner on film pages, the video store carousel row on the home feed, and the "Letterboxd Video Store" row in the search page's "Browse by" list. Can be toggled independently of the Stremio button patch.

patches.name: Hide Where to Watch
patches.description: Hides the "Where to watch" streaming-service icon row on film pages. Can be toggled independently of the other patches.
